title: Time by Moments Steals Away
description: Time by Moments Steals Away in Tonic Solfa to INNOCENTS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 896 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Same”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to INNOCENTS; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Time by mo-ments steals a-way, First the hour and then the day; Small the dail-y loss ap-pears, Yet it soon a-mounts to years.

lines: Time by moments steals away,
First the hour and then the day;
Small the daily loss appears,
Yet it soon amounts to years.
Thus another year is flown;
Now it is no more our own,
If it brought or promised good,
Than the years before the flood.
But may none of us forget
It has left us much in debt;
Who can tell the vast amount
Placed to every one's account!
Favors, from the Lord received,
Sins, that have his spirit grieved,
Marked by an unerring hand,
In his book recorded stand.
If we see another year,
May thy blessing meet us here:
Sun of righteousness, arise,
Warm our hearts and bless our eyes.
